task.description: Root-cause diagnosis (diagnosis only, not the fix) of ISS-0519: Letflow.Entities.Definitions.get_definition_by_name/2 raises Ecto.MultipleResultsError once a tenant legitimately advances a definition to a second version under the same name. Read docs/issues/ISS-0519.yaml in full for the complete symptom description and suggested fix directions. CONFIRM the defect is real and characterize REQ-225/226's ACTUAL intended semantics for 'the definition by this name' when multiple logical_shape_version rows exist under one name -- read REQ-225's and REQ-226's own design docs (lib/letflow/design/req225-entity-definition-schema-validation.md, lib/letflow/design/req226-entity-definitions-persistence-crud.md) and the entity_definitions status/activation model (Letflow.Repository's artifact_activations machinery, REQ-203) to determine whether 'the' definition for a name should resolve to the single ACTIVE version (with multiple simultaneously-active versions under one name being itself an invariant violation to enforce elsewhere), or the latest/newest version by some ordering, or something else. Recommend a concrete, well-justified fix direction and hand off to CODE-DESIGNER.
